test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate direct form of the given sentence.**

Rahul told me he didn’t have time to go to the dispensary as he was getting late for the office.

options.text: Rahul said to me, “He didn’t have time to go to the dispensary as I was getting late for the office.”
Rahul said to me, “I don’t have time to go to the dispensary as I am getting late for the office.”
Rahul said to me, “I haven’t got time to go to the dispensary as I was getting late for the office.”
Rahul said to me, “I couldn’t have time to go to the dispensary as he was getting late for the office.”

solution:
The correct answer is- '**Rahul said to me, “I don’t have time to go to the dispensary as I am getting late for the office.”​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To change the sentence to a direct speech we need to follow the following steps:

 
 
• In the reporting speech, replace the verb '***told***' with '***said to/says*'.**
 
• **The helping verb 'did' will be changed into 'do' and 'was' will be changed into 'am'.**
